label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: y pieles de carneros enrojecidas y pieles de tahash y maderas de shitím,
spanish: y pieles de carneros enrojecidas y pieles de tejones y maderas de acacia,
grammarChanges: Translated תְּחָשִׁים (H8476, common noun, masculine plural absolute) as "tejones" instead of leaving the lemma untranslated as the proper name "tahash".
Translated שִׂטִּים (H7848, common noun, feminine plural absolute, acacia) as "acacia" instead of leaving the lemma untranslated as the proper name "shitím".
readerNote: Chose "tejones" (badger, the primary Strong's H8476 sense) over the alternate seal/sea-cow sense, and kept "enrojecidas" agreeing with pieles rather than carneros, since the Hebrew pual participle, though masculine plural, standardly describes the dyed hides, not the live rams.
